title: Three Summers and One Short Wall
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：garden　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 garden 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 my grandfather ① planted a garden that no neighbour in the yard would have described, and he said the planting was the whole of the summer. The ② garden, meaning the beds themselves and not the lawn, ran three summers and stayed undescribed in the book; a garden, he said, is the only thing in a yard that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ garden in that yard had the same short wall beside it, and the ④ garden at the far corner, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A garden, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; my grandfather said the describing is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the garden was the whole of the matter, meaning the plot and not the beds. The ⑥ garden, meaning the plot and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; garden, he said, is either something you plant or the only word that means both a bed and a plot of ground. He said the plot is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ garden had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short wall. The ⑧ garden of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in November, was one yard and three summers of describing; garden, he said, is either the one at the far corner or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ garden I remember is the one described in the plan, which closed in 1976 and is still described as the quietest in the yard. A ⑩ garden, my mother said in 1978, is the only one that improves by being described; every garden, she said, is a plot that has agreed to look like a bed. She said the plot was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 花园；园圃（指院子里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 花园；园圃（指那些花坛本身，与草坪相对）
C. 固定搭配：plant a garden 种一座花园
D. n. 花园（指留给孩子们的那块地）
E. n. 园艺（抽象总称，指一个院子的园艺之事）
F. n. 花园（指平面图里标出、被丈量过的那处）
G. n. 园地；菜园/果园（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 园地（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: planted a garden that no neighbour in the yard would have described
The garden, meaning the beds themselves and not the lawn
the garden at the far corner
the garden was the whole of the matter
the garden had become a line in a plan
The garden of the whole thing
A garden, my mother said in 1978

answers.why: plant a garden 意为“种一座花园”，1968 年外祖父种了一座院子里没有一位邻居肯描述的花园。
garden 意为“花园、园圃”，指那些花坛本身而不是草坪，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被描述。
garden 意为“花园、园圃”，指院子里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一道矮矮的墙。
garden 意为“花园”，指最远角落留给孩子们的那块地，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
garden 意为“园地”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这块园地就是那件事的全部。
garden 意为“园地”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座花园，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
garden 意为“花园”，指平面图里标出、被丈量过的那处，到 1974 年这一处成了计划里的一行。
garden 意为“园艺”，外祖父十一月写道，整件事的园艺之事是一个院子和三个夏天的描述。
garden 意为“花园”，我记得的是计划里描述过的那处，1976 年完工了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一处。
garden 为抽象总称，母亲 1978 年说，一座花园是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
